categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies AddrMan and CConnman address selection and filtering in src/addrman.cpp and src/net.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents GETADDR responses and getnodeaddresses from returning underfilled sets when many banned or discouraged peers exist in AddrMan. As noted in review, returning full address sets also prevents external peers from deducing ban list sizes.

categories.rationale: Not a member; changes to addrman unit tests and fuzz harnesses belong to p2p rather than general test infrastructure.
